versions.changelog:
**Summary:** This version retires the previous implementation in favor of a new upstream skill.

- All scripts and source files removed
- Updated description to indicate upgrade and deprecation
- Redirects users to https://clawhub.ai/tyxiang/ai-agent-email-skill for the current version
- No further updates or maintenance provided for this version

- Added metadata section to SKILL.md to declare required environment variables.
- Included explicit OpenClaw environment variable requirements and primaryEnv configuration in documentation.
- Added AGENTS.md and requirements.txt files to the skill.
- No changes to the core functionality or skill features.

- Major refactor: introduced modular "scripts/common/" helpers and simplified configuration/authentication
- Replaced `config.sample.toml` with `config.default.toml`; configuration and authentication now auto-detect via environment variables
- Improved OAuth2 and password authentication documentation
- Updated and clarified SKILL.md with new setup, environment variable usage, and script behavior
- Removed legacy scripts/common.py; codebase now more maintainable and consistent

Initial release of the email-skill providing comprehensive script-based email operations.

- Supports IMAP (read, list, mark, move, delete, copy) and SMTP (send, reply, forward) operations.
- Enables mailbox management (folders: create, rename, delete, list).
- Handles both plain-text and HTML emails, with automatic format fallback.
- Supports attachments via base64 encoding.
- Offers multi-account setup, various authentication methods, and automatic email signatures.
- Provides a clear JSON-over-stdin/stdout contract for scripting and integration.
